ideas.pitch: A robust deep metric learning pipeline designed to re-identify individual wild cats and large mammals across varying angles, extreme low-light, and motion blur.
ideas.title: PantheraPrint: Invariant Biometric Re-ID for Camera Traps
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core technical challenge of invariant feature matching under poor image conditions, ensuring a reliable working demo for judges.

ideas.pitch: An edge-deployable intelligence platform that combines acoustic gunshot/chainsaw detection with trail camera image processing to alert rangers of active wildlife crimes.
ideas.title: PoachGuard AI: Multi-Modal Audio & Image Threat Triangulation
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on real-world actionable crime prevention with a live end-to-end alert pipeline that judges can test immediately during the presentation.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite data integration tool that estimates active forest fire perimeters, predicts wind-driven spread velocity, and generates evacuation routing graphs.
ideas.title: PyroPulse: Satellite-Driven Wildfire Spread Predictor and Responder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real geospatial mapping and automated risk modeling, following the proven success formula of complex environmental spatial platforms.

ideas.pitch: An automated OSINT scraper and entity-resolution system that scans illicit online marketplaces and social media channels for illegal wildlife product listings.
ideas.title: FaunaForensic: Wildlife Trade Cyber-Market Crawler and Linker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines graph intelligence with automated text parsing to combat cyber-based wildlife crime, matching the architecture of high-scoring fraud detection platforms.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous multi-agent diagnostic loop that ingests IoT sensor feeds and thermal telemetry to separate false alarms from genuine early-stage forest fire outbreaks.
ideas.title: EcoSentinel: Multi-Agent Forest Health and Thermal Anomaly Inspector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs an advanced multi-agent diagnostic design pattern that provides clear, verifiable reasoning for every triggered emergency response.
